description: Real first-year questions from the CDU New Student Q&A Corner (Student Portal), names removed. 'accept' lists the knowledge-base entries that would correctly answer the question, judged by topic; an empty list means nothing in the knowledge base answers it, so deferring to Student Central is the right outcome. dev = even question ids (used to find gaps and draft new entries); test = odd ids (held out, never used for drafting or tuning).
